entities.title: Lundey
entities.summary: The island the game is set on, and the game's name: "puffin island".

entities.title: Burrow
entities.summary: One level's maze of tunnels cut into the turf, dug from a seed; the score line counts burrows, not levels.

entities.title: Puffin
entities.summary: The player's character; also a life: a game starts with three puffins.

entities.title: Sand eel
entities.summary: What the puffin gathers, one on almost every tunnel tile, 5 points each; a burrow is cleared when the last is eaten.

entities.title: Hunter
entities.summary: One of the four that chase the puffin: Refur the fox, Minkur the mink, Skúmur the skua and Hrafn the raven.

entities.title: Den
entities.summary: The three tiles in the middle of the island where hunters wait and where a routed hunter goes; shut in by turf, with one door above it that only hunters use.
notToBeConfusedWith: A burrow: the puffin's maze, which the den sits in the middle of.

entities.title: Gate
entities.summary: The tunnel tile just above the den's door: where the fox starts, and where a hunter leaving the den is out.

entities.title: Home
entities.summary: The tile under the den where the puffin starts each burrow and each life.

entities.title: Tern's feather
entities.summary: One of four pickups in a burrow, 25 points; picking it up brings the arctic terns.

entities.title: Mobbed
entities.summary: A hunter the terns are at: slow, running from the puffin, and routed if the puffin touches it.

entities.title: Rout
entities.summary: Touching a mobbed hunter: it scores 250 for the first under one feather, then 500, 750 and 1,000, and the hunter runs home to the den.

entities.title: Scent
entities.summary: The trail the puffin leaves: for each tile, when it was last there. The fox follows scent up to eight seconds old.

entities.title: Hunt and prowl
entities.summary: The two moods the fox, the mink and the skua take in turn while out: hunting in their own way, then prowling, turning at random.

entities.title: Dive
entities.summary: The raven's rush at a puffin it has seen down a straight tunnel: three seconds, faster than the puffin on any burrow.

entities.title: Treat
entities.summary: A herring, crab, mussel, starfish or pearl that washes up twice a burrow for ten seconds, worth 100 to 800 by the burrow's number.

entities.title: Clean burrow
entities.summary: A burrow cleared without losing a puffin on it, worth 500.

entities.title: The tunnel off the island
entities.summary: The one row whose tunnel leaves a side of the island and comes back on the other.

entities.title: Season
entities.summary: The island's colours and the name under it, one of five in turn by the burrow's number. It changes nothing in the game.

entities.title: Step
entities.summary: One sixtieth of a second: the unit the engine moves in and counts every time in.
notToBeConfusedWith: A frame the page draws: the screen may draw more or fewer of those than there are steps.

entities.title: Seed
entities.summary: A 32-bit number that fixes a burrow, or every burrow and every random choice of the games a Game plays.

entities.title: Demo
entities.summary: A game the autopilot plays when the title screen is left alone; it scores nothing towards the best.

entities.title: Invited player
entities.summary: A player signed in to icelander.net who holds the role games:lundey, granted at icelander.net/private/admin.
notToBeConfusedWith: A player with games:play, the role the site's other games ask for: it does not open Lundey.
